Name: Gems Recolored
Author: RainRome
Description:
This is a mod that recolors Gems (Ruby, Topaz, Jade, Emerald, Aquamarine, Diamond, Amethyst, Prismatic Shard) and Foraged Minerals (Earth Crystal, Quartz, Frozen Tear, Fire Quartz). The recolors aren't based on anything, they're just my personal taste.

This is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=description]Content Patcher[/url] mod, and requires Content Patcher and [url=http://https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. It was created for Content Patcher 1.24.0.

Each gem's recolor can be individually toggled! Upon running the game, a config.json will appear in the mod folder. Within it there is one variable, "Changed Gems". It can contain as many or as few of the above gems as values, and whichever are not included will not be affected. This is also compatible with the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], which I highly recommend downloading.

Downloads.Description: Unzip this into your mods folder.
